Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of southbound traffic on a Sugar Land roadway when the rear of their vehicle
was struck by Driver 2's vehicle, which had been following too closely. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness
consistent with whiplash and was assisted from the scene by medics. The Passenger, seated in the front right seat,
was also present in the vehicle at the time of impact and confirmed the sequence of events. Driver 2 acknowledged
the collision and stated that they had been distracted briefly before braking. Two independent witnesses in a nearby
vehicle observed the impact and described it the same way the drivers did. Photographs taken at the scene show
rear-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle, with the extent of the damage generally matching the reported speed and
force of the impact. Officers found no sign of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 was identified as a named
insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Both vehicles were driven from the scene after the report was completed.
